description: netbeagle is now nethound: see which process listens on each port, which interfaces reach it, and how everything on your machine connects
notes: netbeagle is now nethound, and this is its last version under the old name. Switch with:
scoop uninstall netbeagle; scoop bucket add nethound https://github.com/michelsalib/scoop-nethound; scoop install nethound/nethound
